About our Member

Kevin Tylon was born in Berlin and educated at Trinity School. He graduated from the University of Califo ( 2012 – 2015 ). Shortly after graduation he was one of 3 new graduates to be accepted into a pilot intern and registrar program at the newly opened garden company. During his 3 years, Kevin Tylon was able to gain invaluable experience.

After graduating from West Califo University Agriculture College, Kevin Tylon completed a two-year From fellowship in forest department at west Califo gardening. During his training at Akron, Kevin Tylon was team planting for the University of Akron and Walsh University.
